name: Copper Terrace
tagline: The operating system for the neighborhoods you steward
positioning: Copper Terrace unifies dues, violations, board votes, and vendor work into one calm ledger built for owner-operated HOA management firms.

hero.h1: Run every association like a flagship community
hero.sub: Copper Terrace replaces the spreadsheets, shared inboxes, and paper ledgers your firm juggles across dozens of boards — one system for dues, violations, and votes.

features.title: The unified ledger
features.description: Every assessment, late fee, and reserve transfer for each association posts to one auditable ledger your treasurer can reconcile in minutes, not weekends.

features.title: Violations that resolve
features.description: Photograph a fence, tag the covenant, and Copper Terrace drafts the notice, tracks the cure window, and escalates on schedule — no cases lost in email.

features.title: Board votes on record
features.description: Post agendas, collect proxies, and capture roll-call motions with a timestamped record that survives any homeowner challenge.

features.title: Vendor work orders
features.description: Dispatch landscapers and pool crews, attach bids, and hold payment until the job photo lands. Every dollar ties back to a line item.

features.title: Reserve foresight
features.description: Model roof, road, and clubhouse replacements against real reserve balances so boards fund the future instead of special-assessing the present.

features.title: Homeowner portal
features.description: Residents pay dues, file requests, and read approved minutes from one branded portal — cutting your front-desk calls in half.

testimonials.quote: We took on nine new associations without adding staff. Copper Terrace's ledger made month-end close feel routine for the first time in twelve years of managing property.
testimonials.name: Dana Whitfield

testimonials.quote: The violations workflow paid for itself in a quarter. Board members finally trust that every notice went out on time and every cure window was tracked.
testimonials.name: Marcus Elle

testimonials.quote: Reserve modeling turned our annual budget meeting from a shouting match into a planning session. I show the board the numbers and the arguments end.
testimonials.name: Priya Sundaram

For growing management companies running many boards at once.
For established firms with multi-region operations and audits.
